<span class="<id>" id="<id>" role="tooltip"> Which turbulence closure the solver uses. k-omega SST is the general-purpose default and handles walls at any y+. k-epsilon and the Reynolds-stress models (LRR, SSG) use high-Re wall functions (y+ above about #).
